intro.vo: Customers and credit. Four simple steps.

beats.caption: Hatua 1: Fungua Menyu kisha Wateja
beats.vo: Step one. Open the menu and tap customers.

beats.caption: Hatua 2: Ongeza mteja na kikomo cha mkopo
beats.vo: Step two. Add a new customer and set their credit limit.

beats.caption: Hatua 3: Fungua mteja kuona deni lake
beats.vo: Step three. Open a customer to see what they owe and what they bought.

beats.caption: Hatua 4: Rekodi malipo ya deni
beats.vo: Step four. When the customer pays back, record the payment and their balance goes down.

endCard.title: Sasampa POS
endCard.subtitle: Tazama mafunzo mengine.
endCard.vo: That is all. Watch our other tutorials to learn more.
